subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Should low-overlap Skill Workshop replacements always override `skills.workshop.approvalPolicy: "auto"` and require an explicit operator approval?
rationale: The exception prevents silent destructive replacement, but it changes a recently merged operator-facing approval contract; code correctness alone cannot establish the intended permanent safety boundary.

options.title: Require approval for risky replacements
options.body: Keep the low-overlap exception so destructive replacements pause even in trusted workspaces configured for automatic lifecycle actions.

options.title: Preserve unconditional auto behavior
options.body: Keep `auto` authoritative and limit this PR to validation, summaries, and rollback visibility, accepting that complete replacements can proceed without another prompt.

recommendation.title: Require approval for risky replacements
recommendation.body: Keep the low-overlap exception so destructive replacements pause even in trusted workspaces configured for automatic lifecycle actions.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns the strongest recent history on the lifecycle approval policy and merged the normal `auto` default being refined here.
